scenes.say: Do straight lines look wavy to you? Here are three signs to check after fifty.

scenes.en: The macula, the centre of the retina, gives sharp central vision. With age it can wear out.
scenes.ta: விழித்திரையின் மையம் தான் தெளிவான பார்வை தருகிறது
scenes.say: A tiny spot at the back of the eye, called the macula, gives you sharp central vision. With age, it can slowly wear out.

scenes.en: Door frames, tiles or lines of text look bent.
scenes.say: Sign one: straight lines, like door frames or floor tiles, look bent or wavy.

scenes.en: A blurry or dark spot in the centre. Faces and small print get harder to see.
scenes.ta: 2. நடுவில் மங்கலான புள்ளி  3. முகம் பார்க்க சிரமம்
scenes.say: Sign two: a blurry or dark spot in the centre. Sign three: faces and small print get harder to see.

scenes.en: Cover one eye. Look at the centre dot of a square grid. Any wavy or missing lines?
scenes.ta: ஒரு கண்ணை மூடி, கட்டத்தின் நடுப்புள்ளியைப் பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: Try an Amsler grid. Cover one eye, and look at the centre dot of a square grid. Wavy or missing lines? Tell an eye doctor.

scenes.en: Studies show it's a leading cause of vision loss in older adults. Smoking raises the risk.
scenes.say: Did you know? It's a leading cause of vision loss in older adults, and smoking raises the risk.

scenes.en: Lines suddenly turn wavy, or a new dark spot appears in the centre.
scenes.ta: திடீர் மாற்றம் வந்தால் உடனே கண் மருத்துவரை பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: See an eye specialist urgently if lines suddenly turn wavy, or a new dark spot appears in your central vision.
After fifty, get your eyes checked regularly. Book an eye test today.
